name: Eastern Junks Shahbandar
role: Fictional reception official for the Chinese-facing constituency
bio: This shahbandar introduces incoming captains to warehouse keepers. The Junk Consignment Guild is one contact, not the whole jurisdiction.
notes: fact: Pires describes a Chinese-facing shahbandar’s constituency but gives no personal name for a 1511 incumbent (Pires II, p. 265; people-factions.md §4)
gameplay: This incumbent and the dealings with Ong Kuan’s guild are fictional; the office is distinct from the player’s port-wide abstraction (people-factions.md §4; port-official.md §4)
